title: QA Fixtures Declaration
description: The parsed form of a QA issue's `### Fixtures` section (#2827): the board state /qa provisions for a manual-only check and tears down afterwards. Board fixtures only — an issue per item, optionally nested one level under a single root. `shape` is derived by the parser, never authored: `tree` when the one root carries children (an epic and its sub-issues), `selection` when every item is a sibling with no children (independent issues, the #2756 shape). The parser (qa-fixtures.js parseFixturesSection) rejects shell metacharacters in titles before validation, because titles reach gh as shell arguments; the pattern here is the same rule stated as data.

items.description: A tree has exactly one root. Two roots would be two epics sharing one teardown record, and the hand-off (`/work <root>`) names one.

title.description: Letters, digits, space and # ( ) . _ : / , - only. No quotes, backticks, $ or other shell metacharacters — the title is passed to gh as a shell argument.

children.description: One level only. A child of a child has no place in the provision order or the hand-off.

labels.description: Always begins with the type, then any `label:<name>` tokens.

reviewed.description: True applies the `reviewed` label directly at provisioning — a scratch issue is not put through /review-issue — and the helper reports it under labeledDirectly.
